title: Djúpivogur: Jökulsárlón & Diamond Beach Cruise Tour
text: Djúpivogur: Jökulsárlón & Diamond Beach Cruise Tour ⁠ ⁠ BOOK NOW English en 简体中文 zh Home Our Chinese Tours Our English Tours Westman Islands Transfers Our Solar Eclipse Tour Shore Excursions Our Northern Lights Tours English Partner Tours Partner Small Group Tours Bus Rental Private Tours Terms & Conditions Contact Special Offers Tour View more Djúpivogur: Jökulsárlón & Diamond Beach Cruise Tour 6 hours and 30 minutes Easy Enjoy a family-friendly shore excursion from Djúpivogur Port to Iceland's stunning southeast coast, featuring Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon, Diamond Beach, and scenic landscapes with a local guide and guaranteed return to your cruise. Experience some of Iceland’s most breathtaking natural wonders on this unforgettable cruise-tailored shore excursion from Djúpivogur Port. This scenic journey along Iceland’s spectacular southeast coast takes you to the world-famous Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon, sparkling Diamond Beach, and dramatic mountain landscapes shaped by glaciers, volcanoes, and the powerful North Atlantic Ocean. Designed specifically for cruise ship passengers, this tour is carefully timed to match your ship’s schedule, ensuring a smooth and stress-free experience with guaranteed return to port no later than 1 hour before your ship’s departure. Your adventure begins with a scenic coastal drive through the remote and beautiful landscapes of East Iceland. Along the way, enjoy a stop at the striking Eystrahorn Mountain, famous for its dramatic jagged peaks rising above black sand beaches and wild coastal scenery. The highlight of the tour is the incredible Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon, one of Iceland’s most iconic destinations. Here, enormous icebergs break away from Europe’s largest glacier and drift peacefully across the lagoon toward the ocean, creating an ever-changing landscape of ice, light, and reflections. Just across the road, you will visit Diamond Beach, where crystal-clear icebergs wash ashore on the black volcanic sand, creating one of Iceland’s most magical natural contrasts. Before returning to Djúpivogur Port, enjoy a scenic stop at Hvalnes Lighthouse, surrounded by dramatic mountains and rugged coastline views that perfectly capture the raw beauty of Icelandic nature. Throughout the tour, your local guide will share stories, local insights, and fascinating information about Iceland’s glaciers, geology, culture, and everyday life. With unforgettable scenery, comfortable transportation, and cruise-tailored timing, this shore excursion is the perfect way to experience the icy beauty of Iceland during your time ashore. What's included? Please follow the instructions provided in your ticket regarding meeting time and location at Djúpivogur Port. We guarantee return to the port no later than 1 hour before your ship’s departure. The tour includes short walks on uneven surfaces and natural terrain. Icelandic weather can change quickly, so we recommend dressing in warm, windproof, and waterproof layers. Comfortable walking shoes are strongly recommended. Food stops may vary depending on the day and tour timing. The order of stops may change due to weather, road, or operational conditions. Suitable for all ages and fitness levels comfortable with light walking.
